messages: Hi Aditya! I'm good. How was your Saturday?
nice. spent the afternoon with my girlfriend Neha, we have been together 2 years now
Two years, that's lovely. What did you two do?
just coffee at Bandra and walked at Carter road. she is a graphic designer, always sketching when we sit
Sounds like a perfect date. Does she show you the sketches?
sometimes. she drew a tiny dog on my napkin lol
That's very sweet. Keep that napkin!
already did. anyway, dinner time. mom made puran poli leftover
Puran poli leftovers are the best kind of leftovers.
we had a movie plan today, i cancelled last minute for the India Pakistan cricket match with friends
Oh. Did you tell her before or after she'd already got ready?
after. she was waiting at the theatre already. she is very angry, not replying
I understand why she's upset. Waiting at the theatre alone hurts. Did you say sorry?
texted sorry but she left me on read
Give her some space tonight, then apologize properly in person or on a call.
yeah. i feel terrible. India won at least lol, but doesnt feel nice
Winning feels hollow when someone you love is hurt. Sleep on it.
we made up! went to her place with a sketchbook as a gift
That's a thoughtful sorry. How did she react?
she cried a little then laughed. said i owe her 3 movies now
Three movies, with no cricket cancellations.
deal. taking her to Bandra on sunday again, her favourite cafe
A lovely plan. Phone on silent this time.
haha yes. also my phone battery died so i charged it all day
heyy. busy week at office, quarter end
Hope you're getting some rest. What do you work on?
i am in sales for an insurance firm. targets every month lol
Quarter ends are intense. Anything keeping you going?
chai and vada pav from the stall downstairs
also bought tickets to watch a movie with Neha on saturday. one of the three
hi aira, mumbai finally cooler in the evenings
Nice, a bit of relief at last. Any plans?
going for a trek to Lonavala this weekend with the gang
Sounds fun. Check the weather first.
will do. packing snacks, wafers and a lot of chocolate
yes. gotta sleep now, 6am start tomorrow
